reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:1c33ab22c8205bf211d4beae419415ae]] I am so happy I found this flairosol hair spray bottle.  It provides the perfect amount of misting that helps me when I am refreshing my day 3 curls or when I am styling after my wash day.  I recommend this to all my curly haired friends because it is so easy to refill and use.. and the pump never stops working!!

reviews.t: Needs to be sent in a box not envelope
reviews.x: The bottle works. It does have a powerful spray. However the packaging was not good. It had a dent in the side of it because it was sent in a padded envelope instead of a box. Luckily the nozzle wasn't damaged and I was able to work the dent out but I bought it for work and couldn't afford to send it back and get a new one.

reviews.t: Has made a big difference! Love it
reviews.x: I love this water bottle! This has made a difference in my 6 year old’s hair care regimen. She has low porosity type 3b/3c curls, and this fine mist helps between wash days to dampen the hair just enough without having to get it soaking wet when not necessary. I know it’s just a water bottle, but it has changed our routine for the better. Dampens, then easy to add product if needed and refreshed curls. 10/10 would recommend, especially to curls girls or mama’s of curly girls.

reviews.t: Every curly hair girl or guy needs this!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:7fc8bfe19a29a244cf5bea86c34ad870]] I absolutely love this bottle.  With the mist spray water isn’t dripping everywhere. I don’t have to keep refilling it up every day like I do with the regular spray bottle. Every easy to use just fill up with water put on the nozzle and spray where you like.

reviews.t: A little exapensive but probably worth it in the long run.
reviews.x: I like how the trigger works on this product. When you pull on the trigger the spray steam is more of a mist and last for 3+ seconds. You can get you hair more evenly wet. My 4 year old with curly hair can use this by herself to get her hair evenly wet.

I have a curly girl! This was a gift and she loved it! Products, including detanglers and leave-in conditioning spray is purchased in bulk around our house!! This hair spray bottle holds a generous amount (so we don’t have to refill as often!!) The fine, continuous spray offered with just a squeeze or two of the handle, does the trick to apply just the right amount! The fun design and Curly Girl logo is spot on!! Great product!!

reviews.t: Best spray bottle I have ever owned.
reviews.x: It has a solid continuous spray. Just what I need to spritz my hair and my flowers!!
This spray bottle is super cute! I love the color and the size is just right.

I have been hesitant to write this review, for fear of jinxing it— but this spray bottle is everything!! I’ve purchased so many over the last year, that ended up broken/unable to spray, in no time at all. I ordered the large one of these on a whim, and have used it daily for the last 2 or 3 months. Easy, smooth continuous mist. Perfect for my hair, well worth the price.

Very cool spray bottle. I was tired of my wife wasting money burning through cheap throw away bottles from Target, Walmart or the Dollar Store. Came across the extended spray bottles by accident and decided to go with this one, I believe based on other reviews. Works as advertised and is really quite magical. It just keeps spraying, kind of like a 3 to 1 ratio, one trigger pull gets you about three sprays worth of water. Really cool. Just recently, my 10 year old got the bright idea, she wanted

reviews.t: Great Spray Bottle and Cute Design - Love the Purple!
reviews.x: I ordered this because I was looking for a spray bottle that sprayed like an aerosol and this is perfect!! I use it to lightly wet my hair to detangle or to lightly moisturize. I love the sizes!! I did learn by using it that if I continue to squeeze the trigger multiple times in a row, that I can get a continuous flow of water to my hair, which has been great so far.  I love the two different sizes!!  I keep one in my bedroom and one in my bathroom. So far, so good!!

I love that this doesn’t just spray for a second and mists your hair in a large area - it mists for like 4 seconds - really nice - I’m actually going to use it one the beach.  I did mix a leave in conditioner in it with the water and if sprays just fine. Buying another one! Btw I have loose wavy curls.

reviews.t: It leaks but a good misting bottle
reviews.x: Big bottle, nice mist action but it leaks. I make my daughter's detangler so it's frustrating to start shaking it up and it leaks.  Husband said he can probably fix it with a cheap o-ring/gasket so I didn't bother returning it. But for the price one would imagine it wouldn't have that major issue.

Lovely bottle that works way better than the traditional spray bottle (pump, pump, pump) that I’ve been using for years. That being said, this is not a “press and hold” bottle. You have to depress the trigger repeatedly, but it’s much smoother and not as often as a traditional spray bottle.

When I got the spray bottle, I loved it because I have locs so I spray my hair daily. I’d have rose water, aloe, glycerin and rosemary oil. It recently stopped misting. It starts to spray like a long small spray. I am so upset because I really enjoyed using it however it didn’t last long.

reviews.t: Air bubbles under sticker that says Curly girl
reviews.x: Flairosol hair spray bottle came in a box well wrapped.  The bottle itself has a sticker wrapped around the bottle with Curlly girl name on it.  The sticker has several air bubbles that I could not press out.  The sprayer itself works very well.

It’s a good mister bottle but the smell is off putting. PI put filtered water in it after washing it, and the water that gets misted out has the most unpleasant odor, like plastic BO. I had to rewash my hair after using, very disappointed.

I really want to like this. But it sprays a few times then not. Then it works again then stops. I ended up pouring the liquid into a cheap sprayer I had to finish my hair. Maybe there is a trick with this I don’t know about?
Nice and big so it hold lots of water. I dilute my leave in conditioner with water as a refresher between shampooing.  My curly hair is ready in a flash. Doesn't drench my hair! Love this sprayer.
I received the item in April and by June the nozzle stopped spraying properly. Now it sprays from the bottom back into the bottle..

reviews.t: A must have for curly hair
reviews.x: Love it make refreshing my hair a breeze.

Ordered this on July 5 2020 and it broke in less than 2 months smh!!! At first I was happy with it because it worked as it should but after using it multiple times it's got looser and looser until it stopped working!  it no longer was spraying any type of water which is ashame! I will no longer buy spray bottles with this type of cap or head whatever you want to call it and unfortunately I didn't take any photos of videos of it not working I just threw it away it wasn't working at all so why kee

I like them other than I felt as tho my skin burned at first, similar to a chemical burn it felt like. I do wish they pushed out a bit more water at each trigger, however I appreciate the elongated spray and the fact that I no longer need to constantly refill the bottle. I use them for filtered water, which I use on my face & hair & body (post shower) I have extreme hard water, sooooooo…… I was constantly filling my other bottles alllll the time. And the sticker or label (obnoxiously 80’s style)

This is one of the best purchases I have made this year. It sprays continually with no problems. It’s sturdy and well made and the size of it allows a lot of water to be used at any given period of time. It’s worth the purchase for sure

Creates a beautiful mist for my self tan application (thanks TikTok). It took me a minute to fully grasp the continuous spray function. You have to continually but lightly pump it, as opposed to just hold down the trigger.

claims.text: Reviewers love the fine, continuous mist that evenly dampens hair without dripping, especially for curly hair care.
The bottle holds a generous amount, reducing how often users need to refill it.
Some users report durability problems, with bottles leaking or stopping misting after a short time.
The trigger requires repeated squeezing rather than press-and-hold, though many find it smooth and easy to use.
Packaging was criticized because the bottle shipped in a padded envelope and arrived dented.
